scheme_name: Assistance on Death- Haryana Silicosis Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be the widow, widower, or nominee of the deceased worker.
The deceased worker must have been suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.
The deceased worker must have been employed in a factory or at a construction site.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 is provided to the widow, widower, or nominee of a deceased silicosis victim.
documents_required: certificate of being the widow/widower or nominee
